title: 10 Things a Godly Man Gives Up for Advent
caption:
Advent is almost here. Most men spend December busier, drunker, and further from God than any other month.

What if this year you gave something up to make room?

The extra drink at the party. The midnight shopping cart. The grudge from last Christmas. The secret tab.

“The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.” John 1:5

Pick two. Kill them before the first Sunday of Advent.

Save this and send it to a brother who'll do it with you.
